senses.gloss: m. h. same, fork, fork-like reed, pronged pole.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:1:10">Y. Erub. I, 18ᶜ</cite> <he>קנה וד׳</he> reed-stem and prongs. Ib. 19ᶜ <he>כמין דק׳</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 4:2:4">Y. Kil. IV, 29ᵇ</cite> <he>כמין דוק׳</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 1:1:7">Y. Succ. I, 52ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>כמין דְּקָרִים</he> (v. <cite ref="D01019"><he>דֶּקֶר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 2:3:3">Y. Shebi. II, 33ᵈ</cite> top <he>עושה לה דיק׳</he> (corr. acc.) he puts under it a pronged prop.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 3:14">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 14</cite> <he>הדוק׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="D00385"><he>דורקין</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>דּוֹקְרָנִים</he>, <he>דּוֹקְרָנִין</he>, <cite ref="D00340"><he>דָּק׳</he></cite>. Y. Kil. l. c. he took <he>דוק׳ וסותם</he> forked reeds with which he closed the breach; Y. Erub. I, 19ᶜ top; Y. Succ. l. c.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 1:4">Tosef. ib. I, 4</cite> if one made a ceiling of the Succah <he>בקנים ובד׳</he> with (plain) reeds and with forked reeds; Bab. ib. 13ᵃ <he>קנים וד׳</he> (Ms. M. 2 <he>קנים הד׳</he>, v. Ar. s. v. <he>דקר</he>), expl. <he>קנים של ד׳</he> pronged reeds.
Tosef. Men. XI, 6 דומין לדק׳ shaped like forks; Men. XI, 6 (96ᵃ) מפוצלין … כמין ד׳ Ar. (ed. omit. כמין ד׳).—*Denom. מְדוּקְרָן fork-shaped.

<cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 4:5">Tosef. Kil. IV, 5</cite> <he>קנים מְדוּקְרָנִים</he>; <cite ref="Eruvin 16a:6">Erub. 16ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 11b:6">11ᵇ</cite> <he>קנים הדוקרנין</he> (Ms. M. <he>הדוקרים</he>).
